notes: AI recognition is now available inside the Product Image Studio, so you can stay in one place.
After recognition the studio shows a clear next step: generate the nine images with the copy already filled in.
The product page also offers a one-tap jump: use the recognition result to generate nine product images.
Credit cost is shown before running recognition (about 3 credits) together with your remaining balance.
Credits are deducted by the same server rules as the home page recognition.
